learning_objective: 🎯 Explore the fantastic internal bodily systems that help animals breathe, digest food, and pump blood to stay wonderfully alive!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Animals cannot make their own food like plants do. The digestive system is a long, incredible tube that breaks down the yummy food an animal eats into tiny, simple nutrients that the body can easily absorb for energy!

Just having food is not enough; the body needs oxygen to unlock that energy! Respiration is the process of breathing in oxygen from the air (or water for fish) and breathing out carbon dioxide waste gas.

Your heart and blood vessels act like a massive highway system. The heart works endlessly to pump blood all over the body, delivering fresh oxygen and nutrients to every single cell and carrying away waste products.

fun_activity.title: ❤️ The Pulse Detective
fun_activity.instructions: Place two fingers gently on the inside of your wrist to find your heartbeat. Count the beats for 30 seconds while resting, then do 20 jumping jacks and count again. See how your heart pumps faster to deliver more oxygen!

quick_recap: ⭐ Life processes are the basic jobs living organisms must do to survive and stay healthy.
⭐ Digestion breaks food down into energy, while excretion removes harmful waste from the body.
⭐ The circulatory system transports oxygen from the lungs and nutrients from the stomach to the rest of the body.
